title: 我和妈妈做饭
text: 在我家里，我和妈妈一起做午饭。今天我想吃鱼，所以我们去商店买了鱼和米。因为我不认识很多菜，所以妈妈教我怎么做。我帮她洗菜，她帮我切鱼。厨房里很热，但是我们很开心。妈妈说我的手很快。我们用了半个小时就做好了。鱼的味道非常好，米饭也很香。我们一边吃饭，一边说话。我觉得妈妈做的菜最好吃。

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 因为…所以…
patterns.explanation: "Because X, therefore Y." Cause-and-effect pair. Either half can be dropped in colloquial speech, but here we only highlight the complete form.
patterns.example_translation: Because it rained, I didn't go.
